# TeX Live packages that the CV needs. The Build CV workflow installs only
# these (TeX-Live/setup-texlive-action), not a full TeX Live, and caches them.
# tlmgr does not install dependencies, so every package must be listed.
# To check the list, see "Check the TeX package list" in README.md.

scheme-basic      # pdfTeX, LaTeX, hyperref, geometry, url, amsfonts, ...
latexmk

# Layout (cv.cls)
enumitem
etoolbox
microtype
xcolor            # accent color for links and section titles
xurl

# Fonts
libertinus        # \usepackage{libertinus}
libertinus-type1  # Libertinus Serif and Mono for pdfTeX
fontaxes          # needed by libertinus-type1
xkeyval           # needed by libertinus-type1
fontawesome5      # icons in the header and award marks
